name: CoinPaprika API
rate_limits: Free tier: 25,000 requests/month. No API key required for basic endpoints.
notes: Strong free crypto API alternative to CoinGecko. No API key required for most endpoints. Covers 2,500+ coins and 300+ exchanges. Includes OHLCV data, tickers, events, and global stats. REST and WebSocket available. Good for AI as a secondary/fallback crypto data source alongside CoinGecko.
